title: TAIFEX daily futures report is CSV with Chinese headers and the adapter writes an empty tombstone
hosted_verification_note: No hosted workflow was dispatched (neither nonprod-deploy.yml nor dev-tw-market-refresh.yml), no VM or SSH access was performed, and no hosted result is claimed. Functional and contract evidence only is recorded here.

summary.daily_market_report_fut_csv_support: Updated taifex_ssf_normalized_rows in services/source_ingestion/connectors/taiwan_official.py to read DailyMarketReportFut rows with either the Chinese CSV column names served by https://openapi.taifex.com.tw/v1/DailyMarketReportFut (日期, 契約代號, 到期月份(週別), 交易時段, 結算價, 合計成交量, 未沖銷契約數) or the existing English JSON keys (Date, Contract, ContractMonth(Week)/ContractMonth, TradingSession, SettlementPrice, Volume, OpenInterest). Added real UTF-8 BOM-prefixed CSV sample fixture services/execution/lean_runtime/fixtures/taifex_20261109/DailyMarketReportFut.csv and README.md.
summary.classified_parse_failure_and_tombstone_g: When DailyMarketReportFut is empty, an error body, has unknown header names, or yields zero single-stock futures regular-session rows, taifex_ssf_normalized_rows raises SourceEvidenceError naming DailyMarketReportFut so IngestionScheduler records the ingest run as failed (validation / source_evidence_rejected) and MarketDataStorageWriter writes no tombstone and no normalized row, keeping the previous good partition in force. A tombstone is emitted only when DailyMarketReportFut was parsed successfully and truly holds no in-scope contract.
summary.workflow_step_order: Reordered .github/workflows/dev-tw-market-refresh.yml so Execute bounded TAIFEX contract refresh (id: taifex_refresh, continue-on-error: true, --non-blocking) runs before Execute bounded Taiwan market refresh (id: refresh) while keeping both steps' egress host lists unchanged.
